execution: unexecuted source fixtures; static inspection only

cases.input: same release identity and complete product bytes on a later generation
cases.expect: verify exact regular-file and directory sets and reuse the existing inode tree

cases.input: same release identity with different, missing or unexpected bytes
cases.expect: refuse; preserve every existing member and previous release

cases.input: an ancestor is a symlink before a missing output parent
cases.expect: no-follow directory open fails before creating anything in the referenced tree
cases.scope: flat generation and relevant manual publication boundaries

cases.input: the pinned output parent is renamed and replaced by a symlink
cases.expect: write only through the original directory descriptor; report outcome unknown on ancestry recheck; do not follow the replacement
cases.scope: flat generation and relevant manual publication boundaries

cases.input: the output parent changes after staging, before the complete tree commit
cases.expect: refuse the commit, retain the original owned staging tree privately and preserve other releases

cases.input: an existing candidate leaf is a FIFO, socket, device or symlink
cases.expect: pin with O_PATH, reject its type before opening content and never block on the leaf

cases.input: a regular candidate member has multiple links or a different owner
cases.expect: refuse before reading or mutating its content
cases.scope: flat generation and relevant manual publication boundaries

cases.input: a checked regular member name changes while its pinned content is read
cases.expect: read the checked inode only; reject the changed path identity and retain all evidence
cases.scope: flat generation and relevant manual publication boundaries

cases.input: size, timestamps or bytes change while verifying a completed candidate
cases.expect: refuse; compare the pinned identity before and after its bounded read
cases.scope: flat generation and relevant manual publication boundaries

cases.input: a previously inspected subtree changes before the verification finishes
cases.expect: the second complete metadata capture differs; refuse reuse or commit

cases.input: directory creation is restricted to owner access
cases.expect: the staging root remains private until complete; published nested directories are explicitly 0755 and files 0644

cases.input: a completed candidate contains an extra empty directory
cases.expect: refuse exact membership validation

cases.input: the release identity already names an empty directory
cases.expect: refuse without replacing the directory or using it as staging

cases.input: traversal, control characters, absolute names, empty components, environment files or a file/directory prefix collision
cases.expect: reject the full product mapping before any output directory is created

cases.input: too many members, directories, bytes, path components or an oversized member
cases.expect: reject during bounded candidate validation; unknown existing entries fail as they are enumerated

cases.input: another cooperating builder owns the pinned output-parent directory lock
cases.expect: The existing suite parent directory inode is locked once for source capture and both flat suite writes. Another builder fails busy immediately, creates no lock file/output directory, and performs no cleanup.
cases.scope: flat generation and relevant manual publication boundaries

cases.input: a cooperating writer finishes before the next writer acquires ownership
cases.expect: the later writer verifies identical bytes and reuses the completed candidate

cases.input: the second product write fails before the whole tree rename
cases.expect: retain the private named staging tree, keep the final identity absent and preserve old releases

cases.input: the destination frontend changes after its initial identity check
cases.expect: refuse replacement, preserve the intervening edit and remove only the writer's exact private temporary inode
cases.scope: flat generation and relevant manual publication boundaries

cases.input: a private file temporary name is replaced with another inode before cleanup
cases.expect: never unlink the replacement or follow its contents; preserve the original destination
cases.scope: flat generation and relevant manual publication boundaries

cases.input: file or complete-tree rename succeeds but parent synchronization or final verification fails
cases.expect: distinct outcome-unknown error with chained cause; the direct Python CLIs return 75 instead of ordinary failure 1; retain the complete candidate and previous releases; never auto-rollback or auto-retry
cases.scope: flat generation and relevant manual publication boundaries

cases.input: generation stops after one checkout preseed update
cases.expect: Static equality and manual served-tree capture reject the mismatched flat checkout pair; make build creates no local served candidate and changes no live pointer.
cases.scope: flat generation and relevant manual publication boundaries

cases.input: the manual activation tool calls the same publication API after its separate authorization and journal checks
cases.expect: preserve its bytes-only API and retained releases; repository implementation never executes the operator tool, including preview

cases.input: generation with valid captured source
cases.expect: Overwrite exactly five generated regular products and preseed.cfg directly in each suite; no release/publication directory, authored-input rewrite or Git ignore.

cases.input: product write fails after an earlier flat file was replaced
cases.expect: Stop with retained diagnostics, leave preseeds unrefreshed when appropriate, require regeneration/static equality before manual serving; no claim of multi-file rollback.

cases.input: operator switches flat served tree before old installer finishes fetching
cases.expect: Trusted pins reject mixed bytes; no old release URL fallback. Operator drains installers before switching or restarts from the chosen trusted preseed.

cases.input: operator switches served tree after installer authenticated and cached its complete payload
cases.expect: Continue exclusively from the bound local snapshot; never probe the new tree for missing members.

limits: Cooperating local builders share the output-parent flock; hostile same-account mutation of the whole checkout remains outside the trust claim.
POSIX rename cannot replace a nonempty completed release; the parent lock and destination recheck protect cooperating writers, including empty reservations.
Descriptor pinning prevents redirected pathname I/O; optimistic identity rechecks are not a filesystem snapshot.
No fixture, operator tool, host helper, service, policy or target installation is executed by static inspection or generation.
